component.name: Stillpage
component.summary: Read and take notes in one calm window

description.p: Stillpage is a quiet reader and notebook. Open a PDF, a Word file, a deck or a folder of notes, write beside it, and keep your music playing, all in one window.

ul.li: Reads PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, EPUB, Markdown, Jupyter notebooks, RTF, HTML, CSV, plain text, images and source code
Split the window into up to four panes, each with its own tabs, and stretch it across two monitors
Write notes beside what you read, with headings, checklists, tables and formulas, and quote a passage straight into a note
Open any folder of notes as it is: new notes are plain Markdown files you can sync however you like
Look up words offline in English and Japanese dictionaries
Play Spotify playlists without leaving the page, with focus playlists one click away
Zen mode, four gentle themes, and a focus timer

description.p: Everything stays on your computer. There are no accounts and no telemetry. The only network calls go to Spotify, and only when you use the music panel.
